sim.capture-note.title: Control notes
sim.capture-note.what: Short notes about a single control.
sim.capture-note.when: When a control needs more context than its label.
howTo: Open the note under the control.
sim.capture-note.verify: The note expands under the control.

sim.library.screen-library.title: Screen set
sim.library.screen-library.what: Switches between the Brightspace screens and the Gradescope screens.
sim.library.screen-library.when: Moving between a Brightspace question and a Gradescope one.
howTo: Choose a set from the list.
sim.library.screen-library.verify: The heading names the set you are in.
gotchas: The Gradescope set is built from vendor guides, so its wording may differ slightly from what an instructor sees.

sim.library.find.title: Find a screen or setting
sim.library.find.what: Searches every screen by title, location and control label, so you can find where a setting lives without knowing the menu structure.
sim.library.find.when: An instructor names a setting and you do not yet know where it lives. This is usually the fastest way in.
howTo: Type part of the setting name, such as Special Access or Calculation.
sim.library.find.verify: The count beside Screen shows how many screens matched.

sim.library.search.title: Search screens
sim.library.search.what: Runs the search you typed and jumps to the first screen that matches.
sim.library.search.when: After typing in the find box.
howTo: Type a term in Find a screen or setting.
sim.library.search.verify: The screen list narrows to the matches and its count updates.

sim.library.screen-picker.title: Screen picker
sim.library.screen-picker.what: Lists every screen in the current set, narrowed by whatever you searched for. Choosing one opens it.
sim.library.screen-picker.when: Browsing screens, or moving between them while working a ticket.
howTo: Open the list and choose a screen.
The page below redraws with that screen’s controls.
sim.library.screen-picker.verify: The blue box under the picker names the screen and where it lives in Brightspace.

sim.library.highlight.title: Jump to a control
sim.library.highlight.what: Outlines one control in red and scrolls to it, which is how you point someone at an exact setting on a busy page.
sim.library.highlight.when: Walking a colleague through where something is, or finding a control on a screen with dozens of them.
howTo: Choose a control from the list.
The page scrolls to it and draws a red outline around it.
sim.library.highlight.verify: The red outline appears on exactly one control.
gotchas: Controls with the same label are listed separately with their section, so pick the one in the right section.

sim.library.replay.title: Guided tour
sim.library.replay.what: Steps through a whole task, outlining each control in turn and explaining why it matters.
sim.library.replay.when: Learning a whole task end to end rather than one setting.
howTo: Open Walkthroughs and choose a tour.
Step through with Next or press Play.
sim.library.replay.verify: Each step outlines one control and explains it.
gotchas: A tour never changes the practice gradebook.

sim.library.page-text.title: Page text
sim.library.page-text.what: The full text of the page, for checking exact wording.
sim.library.page-text.verify: The text matches the page labels.

sim.library.notes.title: Screen notes
sim.library.notes.what: Extra notes about where this screen’s links lead.
sim.library.notes.when: When a link on this screen leads somewhere not shown here.
